title: Scaling the time bound with advice
statement: Let $T_1,T_2,A : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $a \in \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(n) \le a T_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then $\mathrm{DTIMEAdvice}(T_1,A) \subseteq \mathrm{DTIMEAdvice}(T_2,A)$.
